lane_title: Magnetic Pseudogravity Tilt Phase Symmetry for Deep Basement Fault Discovery

ranking.expected_dti_improvement: Medium-High predicted; low-pass pseudogravity emphasizes deep vs shallow volcanic noise
ranking.cost: Low; uses only provided 19-band stack, no external download
ranking.layers: training_features B02 rtp, B13 iso_grav_anom, B15 depth_to_base_surf, B04 geod_2ndinv, B18 iso_grav_anom_hg
ranking.physical_signature: Pseudogravity F/psg=F(rtp)/|k| via FFT (1/|k| integrator) + tilt angle atan(VDR/THDR) zero-contours + RTP demagnetization trough and THDR ridge, depth-stratified
ranking.off_catalogue_rationale: Deep basement steps under 0.5-2 km alluvium have no LiDAR scarp but persist in long-wavelength pseudogravity; shallow volcanic short-λ noise suppressed by 1/|k|
ranking.non_fault_mimic: Shallow Miocene volcanic caldera rims, reversed basalt polarity flows, and GeoDAWN 400m flight-line leveling seams
ranking.difference_from_repo: No prior uses frequency-domain pseudogravity; MRR used spatial block regression, CGO raw gradients, KTH K/Th ratios

ranking.expected_dti_improvement: High; basin horsts have density contrast even when buried
ranking.physical_signature: Horizontal gradient magnitude |∇ iso_grav| maxima + local relief coincidence (buried horst edge) with multi-scale Hessian ridge
ranking.off_catalogue_rationale: Horst-graben density contrast visible in gravity even if buried by alluvium where USGS misses blind intrabasin steps
ranking.non_fault_mimic: Closed playa evaporite margins, perched saline aquifers, Paleogene pluton contacts
ranking.difference_from_repo: Uses gravity HGM not magnetic MRR/tilt; conditions on relief decile

ranking.expected_dti_improvement: Very High; microquakes pinpoint active slip + K washout confirms fluid
ranking.cost: Medium; requires USGS ComCat via fetch_optional_external_data.sh (free official FDSN)
ranking.layers: deq_n100a15 (B10), ieq_n100a15 (B16), geodawn_rad_u8 K (external), geodawn_extensions ThK, topography
ranking.physical_signature: Microseismic density peaks co-located within 300m of K-depletion trough (illitization)
ranking.off_catalogue_rationale: Active blind faults generate micro-earthquakes below surface-mapping threshold; K washout marks hydrothermal flow
ranking.non_fault_mimic: Felsic tuff K-high, U roll-front placers, quarry blasts
ranking.difference_from_repo: First to couple ComCat seismicity directly with radiometric alteration

ranking.physical_signature: Sharp linear NDVI gradient aligned with topographic curvature break (groundwater upwelling)
ranking.off_catalogue_rationale: Fault-plane groundwater pooling creates linear oasis in arid Great Basin
ranking.non_fault_mimic: Irrigation canals, riparian zones, roads, wildfire scars

ranking.layers: Landsat TIR night LST (external) + strike junction density
ranking.physical_signature: Localized emissivity-corrected night temperature anomaly at step-overs/intersections
ranking.off_catalogue_rationale: Geothermal upflow heats surface +1-3K even without vent
ranking.non_fault_mimic: Solar aspect, albedo, wildfire, urban heat island
ranking.difference_from_repo: Direct thermal proxy + kinematics vs magnetics only

holdout: vendor/gems57/evaluate_holdout.py; buffered whole-component hide-and-recover with pixel-exact visible masking; pooled alpha .2 beta .8 300m triangle, paired 20km block-bootstrap if incumbent block terms recoverable
promotion_rule: Beat same-split incumbent HOLDOUT-DTI with positive paired 95% CI and pass uniqueness (sparse ≤0.70, |ρ|≤0.90); no organizer slot consumed here
data_caveat: All layers verified via SHA-pinned training_features.tif (4371c82e…) and geodawn_rad_u8 (c22420f7…); external Sentinel-2/Landsat not used in this rank-1 run. No private fork of vendor template.
